text:
You're not broke. You're unfocused.

Working harder without a clear target just makes you tired. Five hundred wealthy men had one thing in common: they knew exactly what they wanted before they made their first dollar.

Money follows obsession. Not effort.

Pick one thing. Write it down. Build your whole life around it today. That's where rich men start.
caption:
Wealth begins as mental clarity, not hard work. Discipline and self improvement through mindset. That's your success habit.

Send this to a man who needs it today.

#mindset #discipline #wealth #success #intention
